source: Meerstetter TEC Configuration Software v6.31 CoSo BAML/decompile review

100.name: Device Type
100.help: Device type identifier reported by the controller.
100.safety_note: Manufacturer-level diagnostic or identity value; surface as read-only metadata unless separately reviewed.

101.name: Hardware Version
101.help: Hardware version identifier reported by the controller.
101.safety_note: Manufacturer-level diagnostic or identity value; surface as read-only metadata unless separately reviewed.

102.name: Serial Number
102.help: Controller serial number used to keep raw diagnostics tied to the physical unit.

120.name: User Notes
120.help: User note string stored on the controller as non-volatile text metadata.

202.name: Max Input Power Limit
202.help: Input protection limit: the controller calculates a maximum input current using driver input voltage.
202.safety_note: Advanced input-protection limit; changing it can alter current limiting from the measured driver input voltage.

203.name: Input Voltage Range
203.help: Absolute maximum supply-voltage configuration. Wrong values risk hardware damage.
203.safety_note: Manufacturer setting; do not expose as routine operator write.

204.name: Power Stage v3 Mode
204.help: Hardware-test related PowerStage v3 mode flag.

2053.name: Device Address Zero
2053.help: Hardware-test address-zero option; CoSo notes this is usually zero and should not be changed without the TEC grandmaster.
2053.safety_note: Can break addressing and bus recovery.

217.name: FreeRTOS Statistics
217.help: Read-only LATIN1 big-data diagnostics blob containing FreeRTOS statistics.
217.safety_note: Advanced diagnostic value; hide by default and surface with provenance when needed.

250.name: Custom Lock Payload
250.help: Raw custom-lock big-data payload used by CoSo to lock parameter controls and features.
250.safety_note: Write changes the controller lock payload.

1000.name: Object Temperature
1000.help: Measured temperature of the controlled object.

1001.name: Sink Temperature
1001.help: Measured temperature of the heat sink.

1010.name: Target Temperature: Nominal
1010.help: Nominal target temperature used in display-format examples.

1011.name: Nominal Temperature Ramp
1011.help: Effective nominal temperature for the PID controller, usually ramping between the current object temperature and the target.

1020.name: Actual Output Current
1020.help: Measured output current of the TEC output stage.

1021.name: Actual Output Voltage
1021.help: Measured output voltage of the TEC output stage.

1022.name: Actual Output Power
1022.help: Derived or reported output power used for power-supply graphing and limits.

1200.name: Temperature Stable
1200.help: Stability indicator comparing measured temperature against the configured stability window and time.

2000.name: Output Stage Input Selection
2000.help: Selects whether the output stage follows current or voltage input while in output-stage mode.
2000.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

2010.name: Output Enable
2010.help: Toggles the output stage of the TEC controller.
2010.safety_note: Energizes or disables the output stage.

2020.name: Fixed Current
2020.help: Fixed output current command used when operating as a current-limited power supply.
2020.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

2021.name: Fixed Voltage
2021.help: Fixed output voltage command used when operating as a voltage-limited power supply.
2021.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

2030.name: Output Current Limit
2030.help: Output Current Limit restricts maximum output current and also limits the temperature PID controller to prevent integral windup.
2030.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

2031.name: Output Voltage Limit
2031.help: Output Voltage Limit restricts maximum output voltage. In temperature control mode it should not be set so low that the output stage continuously saturates.
2031.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

2032.name: Output Current Error Threshold
2032.help: Overcurrent protection threshold. The controller enters error state and shuts off if output current exceeds this value.
2032.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

2033.name: Output Voltage Error Threshold
2033.help: Overvoltage protection threshold. The controller enters error state and shuts off if output voltage exceeds this value.
2033.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

2040.name: Operating Mode
2040.help: General operating mode selection for off, closed-loop TEC control, constant-voltage supply, or constant-current supply.
2040.safety_note: Changing mode can reset control behavior and should be tracked as a command.

2050.name: Communication Baudrate
2050.help: UART or RS485 baudrate setting; wrong values can cut off serial communication.
2050.safety_note: Can make the device unreachable until recovered locally.

2051.name: RS485 Address
2051.help: MeCom address setting. Wrong address values can make the controller disappear from the expected bus address.
2051.safety_note: Addressing change must be coordinated with bus discovery.

2052.name: Reply Delay
2052.help: UART or RS485 reply-delay timing parameter for bus interoperability.
2052.safety_note: Manufacturer-level setting; keep out of routine operator write controls unless separately reviewed.

2060.name: Connect Watchdog
2060.help: Connection watchdog setting that can influence fail-safe behavior.
2060.safety_note: Manufacturer-level setting; keep out of routine operator write controls unless separately reviewed.

2070.name: CANopen Node ID
2070.help: CANopen node-ID setting; changing it changes where the controller appears on the bus.
2070.safety_note: Can make the controller disappear on CANopen until rediscovered.

2071.name: CANopen Bitrate
2071.help: CANopen bitrate setting; wrong values disconnect the controller from the CAN network.

2072.name: CANopen Enable
2072.safety_note: Manufacturer-level setting; keep out of routine operator write controls unless separately reviewed.

3000.name: Target Temperature
3000.help: Define a target temperature that the load should be regulated to by the temperature controller.
3000.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3002.name: Proximity Width
3002.help: Temperature band around target where the nominal temperature ramp changes to a sine-shaped approach.
3002.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3003.name: Coarse Temperature Ramp
3003.help: Temperature ramp rate used outside the proximity-width band.
3003.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3004.name: Ramp Start Point
3004.help: Selects whether a new ramp starts from object temperature, target temperature, or current ramp temperature.
3004.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3010.name: PID Kp
3010.help: Proportional gain of the temperature PID controller.
3010.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3011.name: PID Ti
3011.help: Integral time of the temperature PID controller.
3011.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3012.name: PID Td
3012.help: Derivative time of the temperature PID controller.
3012.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3013.name: PID D Part PT1
3013.help: PT1 damping for the derivative component of the temperature PID controller.
3013.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3020.name: Thermal Modelization
3020.help: Thermal model selection for Peltier or resistive-heater control behavior.
3020.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3030.name: Peltier Maximal Current
3030.help: Output Current Limit used by the Peltier thermal model to bound the nominal drive current.
3030.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3033.name: Peltier Maximal Temperature Delta
3033.help: Maximum temperature delta expected from the Peltier model.
3033.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3034.name: Peltier Polarity
3034.help: Polarity setting that determines whether positive drive cools or heats the controlled object.
3034.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3040.name: Resistive Heater Resistance
3040.help: Load resistance used by the resistive-heater model.
3040.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3041.name: Resistive Heater Maximal Current
3041.help: Maximum current used by the resistive-heater thermal model.
3041.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3050.name: Lower Boundary
3050.help: Lower boundary for heat-only or cool-only Peltier operation.
3050.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

3051.name: Upper Boundary
3051.help: Upper boundary for heat-only or cool-only Peltier operation.
3051.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

40000.name: Output Stage Temperature
40000.help: Readable output-stage temperature. CoSo exposes individual power-stage temperatures in manufacturer diagnostics.
40000.safety_note: Advanced diagnostic value; hide by default and surface with provenance when needed.

4034.name: Sensor Type
4034.help: Read-only sensor type detected or configured for the temperature measurement input.
4034.safety_note: Advanced diagnostic value; hide by default and surface with provenance when needed.

5001.name: Temperature Calibration Offset
5001.help: Temperature calibration offset for the low-range input.
5001.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

5002.name: Temperature Calibration Gain
5002.help: Temperature calibration gain for the low-range input.
5002.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

5005.name: Temperature Filter PT1 Factor
5005.help: Low-range input PT1 filter factor. Smaller values filter more strongly but add delay.
5005.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

5010.name: Lower Temperature Threshold
5010.help: Temperature limit error threshold for low measured temperatures.
5010.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

5011.name: Upper Temperature Threshold
5011.help: Temperature limit error threshold for high measured temperatures.
5011.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

5012.name: Maximum Temperature Change
5012.help: Throws an error if measured temperature changes faster than this configured limit.
5012.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

5013.name: Temperature Limit Errors
5013.help: Selects which low-range temperature measurement thresholds produce errors.
5013.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6000.name: ADC PGA Gain
6000.help: Programmable-gain amplifier gain for the sensor input path.

6001.name: Current Source
6001.help: Sensor-current source setting; IDAC1 always flows through the instrumentation amplifier.
6001.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6002.name: Reference Series Resistor
6002.help: Reference series resistor used by the sensor measurement conversion.
6002.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6003.name: Sensor Offset
6003.help: Factory calibration offset for the sensor input.
6003.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6004.name: Sensor Gain
6004.help: Factory calibration gain for the sensor input.
6004.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6005.name: Temperature Sensor Type
6005.help: Sensor type selection; changing it can require matching hardware and calibration.

6007.name: PGA Bypass
6007.help: PGA bypass option that can help measurement-noise behavior in some input configurations.
6007.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6008.name: Current Source 2 Output
6008.help: Selects the ADC pin used for the second current source.
6008.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6009.name: Measurement Type
6009.help: Selects resistance or voltage measurement type for the connected sensor.
6009.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6014.name: ADC Limit Errors
6014.help: Selects which ADC thresholds trigger sensor measurement errors.
6014.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6200.name: Fan Enable
6200.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6210.name: Fan Temperature Source
6210.help: Temperature source selection for fan-control behavior.
6210.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6230.name: Fan PWM Frequency
6230.help: PWM frequency selection for fan control.
6230.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6300.name: Object Active Source
6300.help: Object active source selection for deciding which source drives object-temperature control.
6300.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6301.name: Control Cycle
6301.help: Temperature-control cycle selection affecting regulation timing.
6301.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6302.name: Object Observe Mode
6302.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6303.name: Object Observe Mode Variant
6303.help: Second object observe-mode mapping recovered from CoSo import metadata.
6303.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6304.name: Sink Temperature Mode
6304.help: Sink temperature mode selection for external or fixed sink-temperature behavior.
6304.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6310.name: Error State Auto Reset Delay
6310.help: Delay before automatic restart after error state. Zero disables auto-reset; startup adds a delay.
6310.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6320.name: Output Stage Controller Limit Error Delay
6320.help: Delay before output-stage controller-limit error 108 is raised. -1 disables the error and is not recommended.

6330.name: Device Temperature Mode
6330.help: Selects standard or extended device temperature mode; extended mode widens temperature range with current limiting.
6330.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6400.name: Voltage Conversion RT
6400.help: Voltage-conversion calibration coefficient for object-temperature input conversion.
6400.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6401.name: Voltage Conversion RU
6401.help: Voltage-conversion calibration coefficient for object-temperature input conversion.
6401.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

6402.name: Voltage Conversion Slope
6402.help: Voltage-conversion slope calibration for object-temperature input conversion.
6402.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

53000.name: License Key
53000.help: License key field provided by Meerstetter for feature unlocks.

53001.name: License Key Status
53001.help: License key validation status including empty, valid, wrong structure, wrong signature, header failure, wrong device type, or unique ID mismatch.
53001.safety_note: Vendor license status metadata; surface read-only with provenance.

53010.name: Temperature Estimator License Status
53010.help: Feature license status for the temperature estimator.
53010.safety_note: Vendor license status metadata; surface read-only with provenance.

53015.name: Cascade Temperature Control License Status
53015.help: Feature license status for cascade temperature control.
53015.safety_note: Vendor license status metadata; surface read-only with provenance.

53020.name: Unipolar and Mix Operating Mode License Status
53020.help: Feature license status for unipolar and mixed operating modes.
53020.safety_note: Vendor license status metadata; surface read-only with provenance.

53100.name: Estimator Enable
53100.help: Enables the temperature estimator if a valid license is present.
53100.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

53101.name: Estimator Model Input Temperature
53101.help: Selects the temperature input used by the estimator model, such as HR or LR sensors.
53101.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

53102.name: Estimator Ambient Temperature
53102.help: Selects ambient temperature source for the estimator model, including fixed ambient temperature.
53102.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

53103.name: Fixed Ambient Temperature
53103.help: Fixed ambient temperature used by the estimator when no sensor source is selected.
53103.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

53104.name: Estimator Time Constant Damping
53104.help: Damping time constant for the temperature estimator model.
53104.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

53105.name: Estimator Heat Loss Factor
53105.help: Heat-loss factor used by the temperature estimator model.
53105.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

53106.name: Estimator Monitor Input
53106.safety_note: Advanced diagnostic value; hide by default and surface with provenance when needed.

53107.name: Estimator Monitor Output
53107.safety_note: Advanced diagnostic value; hide by default and surface with provenance when needed.

53120.name: Cascade Enable
53120.help: Enables cascade temperature control if a valid cascade license is present.

53121.name: Cascade Current Temperature Selection
53121.help: Selects the current temperature input of the outer cascade control loop, similar to object temperature of that loop.
53121.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53122.name: Cascade Sync Run With
53122.help: Selects the inner temperature-control instance synchronized with the cascade loop.
53122.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53123.name: Cascade Target Temperature
53123.help: Target temperature for the outer cascade loop when cascade temperature control is active.
53123.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53124.name: Cascade Coarse Temperature Ramp
53124.help: Coarse temperature ramp for cascade nominal-temperature generation.
53124.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53125.name: Cascade Proximity Width
53125.help: Proximity width for cascade nominal-temperature ramping.
53125.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53126.name: Cascade Ramp Start Point
53126.help: Selects whether cascade ramping starts from current temperature, target, or ramp value.
53126.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53128.name: Cascade PID Kp
53128.help: Proportional gain for the outer cascade PID controller.
53128.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53129.name: Cascade PID Ti
53129.help: Integral time for the outer cascade PID controller.
53129.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53130.name: Cascade PID Td
53130.help: Derivative time for the outer cascade PID controller.
53130.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53131.name: Cascade PID D Part PT1
53131.help: PT1 damping for the derivative component of the outer cascade PID controller.
53131.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53132.name: Cascade I Freeze Triggered By
53132.help: Freezes the outer PID integral action when the selected inner PID loop runs into limitation.
53132.safety_note: Advanced writable setting; require explicit operator intent, command logging, and confirmed readback before changing.

53133.name: Cascade PID Upper Limit
53133.help: Upper output limit for the outer cascade PID controller.
53133.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53134.name: Cascade PID Lower Limit
53134.help: Lower output limit for the outer cascade PID controller.
53134.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53135.name: Cascade Range Around Target
53135.help: Limits cascade PID output around the target temperature by the configured range.
53135.safety_note: Writable control parameter; log intended value, transport route, actual write result, and confirmed readback.

53136.name: Cascade Current Temperature
53136.help: Monitor value for the cascade outer-loop current temperature.

53137.name: Cascade Nominal Temperature Ramp
53137.help: Monitor value for the cascade nominal target after ramping.

53138.name: Cascade PID Upper Limit Monitor
53138.help: Monitor value for the effective cascade PID upper limit.

53139.name: Cascade PID Lower Limit Monitor
53139.help: Monitor value for the effective cascade PID lower limit.

53140.name: Cascade Output
53140.help: Output of the outer cascade control loop.

65020.name: MeParFlashV2 Write Cycles
65020.help: Flash write-cycle counter; excessive cycles can force read-only behavior.
65020.safety_note: Advanced diagnostic value; hide by default and surface with provenance when needed.

65100.name: PAR_DEBUG
65100.help: Debug parameter family exposed as PAR_DEBUG0 through PAR_DEBUG4 instances.
65100.safety_note: Manufacturer-level diagnostic or identity value; surface as read-only metadata unless separately reviewed.
